title: Noetherian source data and termwise comparison for a proper flat single image
statement: Let f:X→S be proper, locally of finite presentation and quasi-compact, and let F be a finitely presented O_X-module flat over f [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions, def-pc-scheme-module-flat-over]. Supply the independent derived localizations on X, S, an open U of S, and the localized sites of U [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. For each x∈U there is a neighbourhood V in U, an affine scheme T, a compact open W of T with W Noetherian, a scheme Y and a proper map p:Y→W. With auxiliary derived localizations in universe u+1, there is A∈D(O_Y) with bounded coherent cohomology [pqf-def-coherent]. There is a map g:V→W and an additive functor L from O_T-modules to modules on the localized site of V, isomorphic to ordinary tensor pullback along g followed by W→T, then the inverse localized-site equivalence [def-pc-module-pullback]. For every bounded-above finite-free complex P on T whose exact restriction to W is isomorphic to Rp_*A [def-pc-derived-direct-image], the exact localized restriction to V of (Rf_*F[0])|U is isomorphic to Q(L(P)), where L acts termwise. This statement supplies no finite-free representative of Rp_*A and asserts no pseudo-coherence of either direct image.

proof.text: Choose an affine neighbourhood V of x in U. Restrict the tensor data E=O_X and G=F[0] to its inverse image. Properness makes the support of F proper over the base. Write the affine ring as the filtered colimit of finitely generated Z-subalgebras and use noetherian_approximation_data to descend the morphism, the perfect unit and the bounded flat proper-support complex. Enlarge the stage further using eventual properness to make the descended morphism proper. Use standard derived localizations in universe u+1 on all auxiliary schemes and localized sites. Set T=Spec of the stage ring and W=top, with the canonical total-open identification. The descended morphism p:Y→W is finitely presented; W is Noetherian and T affine, and W is compact.

Let A be the descended perfect tensor bounded-complex object on Y. Finite presentation and quasi-compactness over the Noetherian W make Y Noetherian. Finitely presented terms are coherent. Apply perfect_tensor_bounded_coherent to obtain bounded coherent source cohomology. Package these two source hypotheses on A, and the properness of p already obtained in the approximation step, without asserting any property of Rp_*A.

Let g:V→W be the comparison and L=tensorPullback(g≫W.ι) followed by the inverse localized-site equivalence. The tensor-pullback adjunction gives additivity; the equivalence is exact and additive. Given any bounded-above finite-free P on T with its restriction representing Rp_*A, its terms are flat and P is K-flat. Compute derived pullback termwise. Relatively flat derived base change applied to the descended tensor data and the descended object/complex identifications gives the original image on V. Compose with open direct-image restriction. Localization uniqueness identifies Q-images under the independent supplied localizations: both right-derived images are computed from the same K-injective resolution, and exact site equivalences descend along Q. This constructs the comparison for every such P, without constructing or postulating a P. Empty U has no x; zero F descends zero tensor data.
